title: Dilation invariance of weighted approximate tangent spaces
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, let M ⊆ ℝ^N (Eucl N), θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N, and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^N. Suppose Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.7 (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q). Then Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of the dilated pair (ρM, θ(ρ⁻¹·)) at ρx, where ρM = {ρz : z ∈ M}. In Lean: HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k ((fun y => ρ • y) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (ρ • x) Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (x : Eucl N) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k ((fun y : Eucl N => ρ • y) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (ρ • x) Q
